parameters.query: SELECT t.id AS tid, t.code, t.name AS tname, t.status, t.sport, t.organizer_user_id, (t.registration_deadline < NOW()) AS closed, viewer.id AS viewer_id, viewer.name AS viewer_name, p.accept_cash, p.upi_id, d.id AS did, d.name AS dname, d.min_age, d.max_age, d.squad_min, d.squad_max, d.max_teams, d.entry_fee, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_entries e WHERE e.division_id = d.id AND e.status = 'APPROVED') AS approved, tm.id AS team_id, tm.name AS team_name, tm.sport AS team_sport, (SELECT x.role FROM team_members x WHERE x.team_id = tm.id AND x.user_id = viewer.id AND x.status = 'ACTIVE') AS my_role, (SELECT e.id FROM tournament_entries e WHERE e.tournament_id = t.id AND e.team_id = tm.id) AS existing_id, (SELECT e.status FROM tournament_entries e WHERE e.tournament_id = t.id AND e.team_id = tm.id) AS existing_status, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', x.id, 'user_id', x.user_id, 'role', x.role, 'name', COALESCE(u.name, x.guest_name),   'age', TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, COALESCE(u.birthdate, x.guest_birthdate), t.start_date),   'jersey_name', COALESCE(x.jersey_name, u.jersey_name), 'jersey_number', COALESCE(x.jersey_number, u.jersey_number),   'jersey_size', u.jersey_size, 'food_pref', u.food_pref))  FROM team_members x LEFT JOIN app_users u ON u.id = x.user_id WHERE x.team_id = tm.id AND x.status = 'ACTIVE') AS members, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(ep.user_id) FROM tournament_entry_players ep JOIN tournament_entries e2 ON e2.id = ep.entry_id  WHERE ep.tournament_id = t.id AND ep.user_id IS NOT NULL AND e2.team_id <> tm.id AND e2.status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'WAITLISTED')) AS taken FROM tournaments t JOIN app_users viewer ON viewer.phone = $1 LEFT JOIN tournament_payment_details p ON p.tournament_id = t.id LEFT JOIN tournament_divisions d ON d.tournament_id = t.id AND d.id = $3 LEFT JOIN teams tm ON tm.code = $4 WHERE t.code = $2
